item.title: Men's Tennis Battles Vanderbilt
item.description: NASHVILLE – The Lipscomb University Men's Tennis team dropped a 7-0 decision to Vanderbilt University on Sunday evening from the Lummis Family Tennis Center.

item.title: Putting on the Miles; Eighth Inning Rally Lifts Baseball to Series Win over Dayton
item.description: NASHVILLE – Hutson Miles' eighth inning double was enough for the Lipscomb University Baseball team to take down the University of Dayton to take the rubber-match of the first series of 2026, 9-6, Sunday afternoon into the evening from Ken Dugan Field at Stephen Lee Marsh Stadium.

item.title: Baseball Unable to Capitalize Late at Tennessee Tech
item.description: COOKEVILLE, Tenn. – The Lipscomb University Baseball team could not record the counter punch late in the game at Tennessee Technological University, as the Golden Eagles defeated the Bisons, 7-5, Tuesday evening inside Bush Stadium.

item.title: Men's Golf Competes at The Prestige
item.description: La Quinta, Calif. – Lipscomb Men's Golf competed at The Prestige, finishing 18th in a loaded field of 24 teams. The field includes nine top-50 teams and three top-30 teams.

item.title: Women's Basketball Suffers Heartbreaker to West Georgia in Overtime
item.description: NASHVILLE – Despite the Lipscomb University Women's Basketball team setting school records for most blocks in a game and most blocks in a season on Wednesday night, the University of West Georgia spoiled the party with a 66-65 win over the Bisons in overtime inside Allen Arena.

item.title: Men's Basketball Wins Thriller at Bellarmine
Bisons Battle Baylor, Fall to Clemson on Day One of Clemson Tournament
item.description: CLEMSON, SC – Lipscomb Softball opened play Friday at the Clemson Tournament with two competitive matchups, dropping a two-run decision to Baylor before falling to host Clemson in the followup.

item.title: Baseball Falls in Extras to Villanova
item.description: NASHVILLE – The Lipscomb University Baseball team saw Villanova University score six in the top of the 10th inning to defeat the Bisons in the opening game of the three-game series, 11-5, Friday night inside Ken Dugan Field at Stephen Lee Marsh Stadium.

item.title: Women's Tennis Drops Match at No. 28 Vanderbilt
item.description: NASHVILLE – The Lipscomb University Women's Tennis team battled a Vanderbilt University squad that saw six of the nine flights between singles and doubles ranked, as the Commodores swept the Bisons 7-0 on Friday evening from the Lummis Family Tennis Center.

item.title: Ushizima Sweeps Friday's Action; Men's Tennis Splits Opening Day of Arizona Trip
item.description: GLENDALE, Ariz. / PHOENIX – The Lipscomb University Men's Tennis team split on the team's first day of competition in Arizona, as the Bisons defeated Arizona Christian University, 4-1, before falling to No. 60 Grand Canyon University 6-1.
